text:
maya: Kicking off staged rollout for v2.3.1. Targeting 10% global with a 5% eu-west canary. Change window 16:00-18:00 UTC. Ping @cheng @jordan for ops sweep. Deploy bot should post status updates.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: v2.3.1 -> canary eu-west 5% / global target 10%. Health checks running.

cheng: seeing a P50 latency bump in eu-west from ~85ms -> ~120ms over last 3m. No user-facing errors yet but it's trending up. leaning to hold.

jordan: error rate on embedding-service for v2.3.1 in eu-west is 0.8% (baseline 0.02%). tracing shows intermittent OOMs in quantized runner. uploading snippets to the thread.

sarah: agree with a hold. recommend pin eu-west back to v2.3.0 and stop any further ramp while we triage. keep non-eu traffic at current 10% for now.

leo: can we do a region-scoped rollback so only eu-west is affected? ops-bot, is that in the runbook?

ops-bot: Region-scoped rollback is supported.
Run: deploy rollback --region eu-west --to v2.3.0 --force-safe
This will open rollback ticket RB-4523 and run health checks after completion.

maya: OK executing region rollback for eu-west and pausing global ramp. @deploy-bot please run the rollback command and confirm when complete.

deploy-bot: Running rollback now...

```
rollback --region eu-west --version v2.3.0 --wait
```

Status: started (progress will be posted).

deploy-bot: eu-west rollback complete. Traffic in eu-west pinned to v2.3.0 at 5%. Global ramp paused at 10%.

cheng: Post-rollback metrics: P50 back to ~82ms, error rate returned to baseline. Looks stable. Recommend hold for 30m then reassess.

jordan: filing bug EMB-987 with attached traces and quantization notes, assigning to infra-ml. Link: https://tracker.internal/EMB-987

sarah: updating release notes and notifying pager rotation for canary incident. Change window still open; will monitor.

maya: Decision: STOP further rollout until infra-ml investigates EMB-987. Hold current traffic and reconvene in +30m. Tagging stakeholders: @leo @sarah @cheng

leo: :thumbsup: I'll update the rollout dashboard and runbook to reflect the pin and the region rollback notes.
